buildings.name: Windmill
buildings.role: Grain milling — flour production
buildings.loreHook: Visible from a day's walk in every direction

buildings.name: Brewery
buildings.role: Ale and mead production
buildings.loreHook: The brewmaster is the most popular person in town and knows it

buildings.name: Workshop
buildings.role: General crafting — carpentry, weaving, toolmaking
buildings.loreHook: If it can be fixed, it gets fixed here. If not, it becomes something else

buildings.name: Lumberyard
buildings.role: Timber staging and storage
buildings.loreHook: Log stacks higher than the houses — a good sign or a dangerous one

buildings.name: Salt Works
buildings.role: Salt extraction or evaporation — critical for preservation
buildings.loreHook: Salt is money that everyone needs

buildings.name: Granary
buildings.role: Grain storage — the settlement's food insurance
buildings.loreHook: Guarded more carefully than the treasury — you can't eat coins

buildings.name: Barn
buildings.role: Livestock shelter and feed storage
buildings.loreHook: Warm in winter. The animals share that warmth whether you like it or not

buildings.name: Palisade Gate
buildings.role: Main entry through the settlement wall
buildings.loreHook: Closed at dusk. No exceptions. Well — some exceptions

buildings.name: Barracks
buildings.role: Garrison housing — soldiers, militia, or hired guards
buildings.loreHook: Order, discipline, and complaints about the food

buildings.name: Armory
buildings.role: Weapons and armour storage — locked and guarded
buildings.loreHook: The key is held by two people who don't trust each other

buildings.name: Training Yard
buildings.role: Open ground for drills and sparring
buildings.loreHook: The sound of wooden swords at dawn is the settlement's alarm clock

buildings.name: Smokehouse
buildings.role: Fish or meat curing and preservation
buildings.loreHook: The smell is terrible and the product is delicious

buildings.name: Tannery
buildings.role: Leather processing — hides to workable leather
buildings.loreHook: Downwind for a reason

buildings.name: Fishing Dock
buildings.role: Boat mooring and catch landing
buildings.loreHook: The nets are mended at dawn, the stories at dusk

buildings.name: Temple
buildings.role: Major religious structure — ceremonies, healing, arbitration
buildings.loreHook: The priests argue about doctrine while the roof leaks

buildings.name: Pilgrim Shelter
buildings.role: Free lodging for religious travellers
buildings.loreHook: Free bed, free meal, mandatory sermon

buildings.name: Sacred Grove
buildings.role: Natural ritual space — trees, stones, and silence
buildings.loreHook: The trees here are older than the settlement. They were here first

buildings.name: Graveyard
buildings.role: Burial ground — the settlement's memory
buildings.loreHook: The oldest stones have names no one remembers

buildings.name: Storage Shed
buildings.role: General-purpose storage — tools, supplies, seasonal goods
buildings.loreHook: Contains exactly what you need, if you can find it

buildings.name: Root Cellar
buildings.role: Underground cold storage for food preservation
buildings.loreHook: Cool, dark, and full of things in jars

buildings.name: Bridge
buildings.role: River or stream crossing within or adjacent to the settlement
buildings.loreHook: Someone has to maintain it. That someone is never decided

buildings.name: Customs Post
buildings.role: Trade inspection and tax collection point
buildings.loreHook: The tariff schedule is posted. Nobody reads it. Everyone complains

buildings.name: Harbour Dock
buildings.role: Deep-water mooring for trade and passenger vessels
buildings.loreHook: The harbour master's word is law from the tideline to the breakwater

buildings.name: Boat Shed
buildings.role: Boat construction and winter storage
buildings.loreHook: A boat upside-down on sawhorses is a promise of spring

buildings.name: Hero's House
buildings.role: Home of a retired adventurer — large, eccentric, trophies visible
buildings.loreHook: The old warrior keeps a sword above the fireplace. It is not decorative

buildings.name: Mage Tower
buildings.role: Wizard's residence and laboratory — tall, isolated, slightly unsettling
buildings.loreHook: Lights at odd hours. Sounds that might be thunder. Best not to ask

buildings.name: Incorporated Ruin
buildings.role: An Earth-era structure repurposed as a settlement building
buildings.loreHook: The walls are made of something no one can name. They don't crack

buildings.name: Cursed Lot
buildings.role: Empty plot with scorch marks — no one builds here
buildings.loreHook: Three houses were built here. None lasted a season

buildings.name: Grand Relic
buildings.role: A building far too grand for the settlement's current size — former glory
buildings.loreHook: This was a great hall once. The town shrank but the building didn't

buildings.name: Refugee Quarter
buildings.role: Cluster of mismatched shelters outside the settlement core
buildings.loreHook: They came from somewhere else. They don't talk about it

buildings.name: Strange Shrine
buildings.role: A small devotional site to something not quite right
buildings.loreHook: The offerings left here are not food or coin. They are teeth

buildings.name: Mechanical Oddity
buildings.role: Earth-tech still functioning — generator, pump, or light source
buildings.loreHook: It hums. It has always hummed. Nobody touches it

buildings.name: Campfire
buildings.role: Communal gathering point for outposts too small for a plaza
buildings.loreHook: The fire is never allowed to go out

buildings.name: Well
buildings.role: Water source — social gathering point
buildings.loreHook: Children are warned not to look too deep

buildings.name: Shelter Hut
buildings.role: Minimal one-room shelter — seasonal workers, shepherds, scouts
buildings.loreHook: Four walls and a roof — what more do you need

buildings.name: Cottage
buildings.role: Single-family home — the basic residential unit
buildings.loreHook: Smoke from the hearth means someone is home

buildings.name: Dwelling
buildings.role: Larger family home — wealthier residents or extended families
buildings.loreHook: A second story means old money or new ambition

buildings.name: Longhouse
buildings.role: Communal hall — eating, meeting, sleeping for the settlement's core families
buildings.loreHook: The chief's seat faces the door so they see everyone who enters

buildings.name: Market Hall
buildings.role: Covered trading floor — the economic anchor of larger settlements
buildings.loreHook: The bell rings at dawn and dusk to mark trading hours

buildings.name: Dormitory
buildings.role: Shared sleeping quarters — workers, soldiers, or pilgrims
buildings.loreHook: Thirty bunks, no privacy, and someone always snores

buildings.name: Inn
buildings.role: Lodging and drink for travellers — the settlement's social hub after dark
buildings.loreHook: The innkeeper knows everything and says nothing — for the right price

buildings.name: Tavern
buildings.role: Drinking hall — cheaper and rougher than the inn
buildings.loreHook: The floor is sticky for reasons nobody investigates

buildings.name: Merchant Stall
buildings.role: Open-air trading booth — semi-permanent market presence
buildings.loreHook: Everything is negotiable, especially the truth about the merchandise

buildings.name: Warehouse
buildings.role: Bulk goods storage — trade inventory, seasonal surplus, import staging
buildings.loreHook: Rats are the unofficial inventory auditors

buildings.name: Stables
buildings.role: Mounts and draft animals — essential for overland trade
buildings.loreHook: The stablehand knows which travellers are trouble before anyone else

buildings.name: Smithy
buildings.role: Metalworking — tools, weapons, repair
buildings.loreHook: The smith is always the last to sleep and the first to be needed

buildings.name: Sawmill
buildings.role: Timber processing — logs to planks
buildings.loreHook: The whine of the blade carries for miles

buildings.name: Guard Post
buildings.role: Small checkpoint — toll collection or patrol staging
buildings.loreHook: Papers, please

buildings.name: Watchtower
buildings.role: Elevated lookout point — early warning
buildings.loreHook: The watch is boring until it isn't

buildings.name: Shrine
buildings.role: Small devotional site — a carved stone, an altar, a sacred tree
buildings.loreHook: Offerings appear overnight — nobody admits to leaving them

buildings.name: Manor
buildings.role: Estate of the settlement's most prominent family
buildings.loreHook: The family claims they built it themselves. No one believes them

buildings.name: Town Hall
buildings.role: Administrative seat — the settlement leader governs from here
buildings.loreHook: Disputes are settled here, badly

buildings.name: Net Shed
buildings.role: Storage and repair for fishing gear
buildings.loreHook: Smells of salt and tar and old rope

buildings.name: Farmstead
buildings.role: Combined home and working farm — house, outbuilding, and fenced plot
buildings.loreHook: The fence keeps the goats in and the wolves out. Usually

buildings.name: Smelter
buildings.role: Ore processing — raw rock to usable metal
buildings.loreHook: The smoke is black and the workers are blackened

buildings.name: Mine Entrance
buildings.role: Shaft head and staging area for underground extraction
buildings.loreHook: The older miners listen to the rock. The younger ones learn to

buildings.name: Kiln
buildings.role: Pottery and brick firing
buildings.loreHook: The kiln-master can judge temperature by the colour of the flame

buildings.name: Caravansary
buildings.role: Fortified caravan rest stop — secure yard, animal pens, merchant lodging
buildings.loreHook: The walls keep the goods safe and the deals private
